tex_content.html:
Lemma
[The pair $(M_f, X)$ has the homotopy extension property]

↗ def:mapping-cylinder ↗ def:homotopy-extension-property

\group CW Complexes

For any $f:X\to Y$, the pair $(M_f,X)$, with $X=X\times \{ 0\} \subset M_f$, has HEP.

Proof

\sketch For a map $\varphi :M_f\to Z$ and a homotopy $h:X\times I\to Z$ of its restriction, project $I\times I$ from $(1,2)$ onto the bottom and left edges. The projection is

\[ \alpha (s,t)=\frac{2s-t}{2-t}\quad (t\le 2s),\qquad \beta (s,t)=\frac{t-2s}{1-s}\quad (t\ge 2s). \]

Define $F([x,s],t)=\varphi [x,\alpha (s,t)]$ in the first region and $F([x,s],t)=h(x,\beta (s,t))$ in the second, while setting $F([y],t)=\varphi [y]$. The formulas agree on $t=2s$, respect the mapping-cylinder quotient, and satisfy $F(\cdot ,0)=\varphi $ and $F([x,0],t)=h(x,t)$.

□
